claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor
claims.evidence: Model name matches witness-read label (EOS 5D Mark II), but sensor resolution and sensor condition cannot be confirmed from exterior photos alone.
Witness report shows 'Canon' logo on front, rear, and the bottom label plate ('CANON INC MADE IN JAPAN', model DS126201). No Sony markings anywhere.

risks.risk: Shutter count / real usage history unknown
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from a diagnostic app or EXIF data, or a clear photo of the menu's shutter actuation counter.
risks.if_unproven: price as heavily used / high-shutter-count body

risks.risk: Sensor/interior condition (dust, fungus, scratches) not visible with body cap on
risks.proof: Photo of sensor with mount open and body cap removed, in good light.

risks.risk: Functionality of buttons, dials, AF system, and shutter unverified
risks.proof: Video clip showing camera powering on, AF engaging on a lens, and shutter firing.

risks.risk: No battery, charger, memory card, lens, strap, or case confirmed included
risks.proof: Single photo showing all included accessories laid out together.

risks.risk: LCD screen cosmetic condition (scratches, dead pixels) not confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up photo of screen powered on displaying an image or menu.
risks.if_unproven: price as having a worn/damaged screen

risks.proof: Photos of screws/seals for tamper signs, or seller-provided service receipts.
risks.if_unproven: price as possibly repaired with non-original parts

risks.risk: Unexplained brand contradiction in seller's text (claims Sony) suggests copy-pasted or mismatched listing
risks.proof: Seller must clarify and re-confirm brand/model in their own words, ideally with a fresh photo holding a paper with date and listing ID.
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as unreliable until clarified

proof_requests: Clarify why the text states 'The brand is Sony' when all photographed markings say Canon.
Photo of sensor with body cap/mount cover removed.
Shutter count screenshot or EXIF data from a recent photo.
Video of camera powering on, autofocus engaging, and shutter firing.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, memory card, lens, strap, case, manuals, box).
Close-up of LCD screen powered on.
response.reason: The seller's text directly contradicts the witness's photographic evidence by claiming the brand is Sony when the body is clearly marked Canon throughout, a red flag for a mismatched or scam listing that must be resolved before any pricing.
